mentions.story: You're not the CEO - You're the Fucking Janitor
mentions.why: Parable that leaders must handle the unpleasant work nobody else will
mentions.quote: regardless of the size of the organization, its leaders are the ones who must deal with the stuff no one else can or wants to tackle.
